title: daucus carota subsp. boissieri
intro: Daucus carota subsp. boissieri, commonly known as wild carrot, is a subspecies of the carrot plant that grows in the wild. The health benefits of wild carrot include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of wild carrot include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of wild carrot include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, such as limonene and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
